scope: Only staging data.ts, new lazy canonical resolver and tests changed; no banks, API or root UI edits.
hash_contract: SHA256(JSON.stringify(full original canonical question)) or exact accepted edit.question. Explicit canonical contentVersion retained; injected runtime contentVersion excluded. This matches server/learning-bank.ts. Case children inherit parent snapshot version.
overlay_contract: Shallow immutable source arrays captured before public overlays. Private rebuild reuses applyPublishedEdits guards for source hash, question ID, lecture routing, created collisions and deletions.
cache_contract: Lazy requested module/chapter; caches promise by correctionRevision; returns defensive Map copy; rejects remove cache; retries on revision race. No new eager whole-catalog hashes.
limitations: Root hook/UI integration and full independent final review pending; no full suite/build or browser review here.
Review now involves a requested resolver implementation, so final report must distinguish authored resolver from independent root UI inspection.
